# Clawd Slayer

> The Clawd Slayer showcase page for Clawd Clash, a free macOS app that shows your AI coding sessions (Claude Code, and the other AIs and harnesses it supports) as a pixel-art battle on the desktop or in a window. Every session is a hero or a villain, every subagent joins in, and they fight while they work. This repo holds no code: it only shows off the Clawd Slayer universe (pictures, a promo video and a plain-language changelog).

- Clawd Slayer is the Buffy the Vampire Slayer parody universe of Clawd Clash, from Buffy the Vampire Slayer and its spin-off Angel: 48 villains and 35 heroes (Buffy Clawdmers, Willow Rosenclawd, Xander Harrows, Rupert Gyles, Cordelia Chaise, Spyke, Faith Lehayne, Angstel, the Old Master, Drusillah, Mayor Wilclawds, Glorificlawds, the First Evil, Dark Willow, the Gentlemen and more) and 20 places (the Sunnydale High Library, the Bronze, Restfield Cemetery, the Magic Box, Spyke's Crypt, the Hellmouth, the Hyperion Hotel, Wolfram & Hart and more).
- Set pieces: the school bus, Spyke's DeSoto and Angstel's convertible pick people up; Tabula Rasa on context compaction (a crystal, "JOAN?", then it cracks and they remember); Hush (with the Gentlemen on stage every speech bubble is empty); Ozz and Veruka stay wolves when the real moon is full; the First Evil wears the Big Bads before it; the Mayor's wet wipe; thirteen transitions (the opening titles, Dusting, the Watcher's tome, Willow's spell, Bored Now, the Hellmouth, Hush, Once More With Feeling, sunrise, the Key's portal, the coat swish, the Wolfram & Hart lift, Restless).
- Install: Clawd Slayer ships with Clawd Clash 3.7.0 and later (`brew tap rodclemen/tap && brew install --cask clawd-clash`, then Settings → Universe → Clawd Slayer).
- The app, its source, docs and full history: https://github.com/rodclemen/clawd-clash
- The other universes: Star Clawds, Marvelous Clawds, Detective Clawds, Doctor Clawd, The Clawd Files, Stevie Clawdberg and Clawd of the Rings, and Clawd Royale, which puts them all in one scene.
